title: Sage levelling record
description: A levelling record (LevellingRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another levelling record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

level.description: The attribute that is the level. Names a attribute record. (RecordRef<AttributeRecord>)

points.description: The attribute its points gather in: skill rises, or experience from an attribute_gain. Names a attribute record. (RecordRef<AttributeRecord>)

rate.description: Points from the first level to the second; from level l it takes rate × (1 + growth × (l − 1)) At least 0. (float, default 10)

growth.description: How much more each level asks than the last, as a share of rate: 0 = always rate (Morrowind's ten rises) At least 0. (float, default 0)

attributeBonus.description: What a level gives each governing attribute by how many rises its skills had since the last: the highest step reached counts. (List<AttributeBonusStep>)

rises.description: Rises of the skills it governs since the last level. At least 1. (int)

gain.description: What the governing attribute gains at the level. (float)

attributeBonus+.description: Adds to "attributeBonus": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

rises.description: Rises of the skills it governs since the last level. At least 1. (int)

gain.description: What the governing attribute gains at the level. (float)

attributeBonus-.description: Removes these from "attributeBonus" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

rises.description: Rises of the skills it governs since the last level. At least 1. (int)

gain.description: What the governing attribute gains at the level. (float)

effects.description: Applied at each level (health +10, a perk); their source is the one levelling. Names a effect record. (List<RecordRef<EffectRecord>>)

effects+.description: Adds to "effects": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

effects-.description: Removes these from "effects" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).
